verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਕਰਉ ਨ ਅਹਾਰ ਮਾਸ ਮੂਸਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਦਉਰੇ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau kahai ma(n)jaar karau na ahaar maas moosaa dhekh paachhai dhaure dheer na dharat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tom cat says that he has stopped eating meat but as soon as he sees a mouse runs after him (cannot control his desire to eat him up).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਰੀਸ ਕੈ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kuooaa rees kai maraal sabhaa jai baiThe chhaadd mukataahal dhuraga(n)dh simarat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a crow goes and sit among swans but leaving aside pearls which is the food of swans, he always desires to eat filth and dross.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਤਨ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਿਆਰ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise mon geh siaar karat anek jatan sunat siaar bhaakhiaa rahio na parat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a jackal may try myriad times to keep quiet but listening to other jackals just by the force of habit, cannot help howling.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਨ ਕਹਤ ਕੈ ਛਾਡਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਟੇਵ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੩੯॥
verses.translit_en: taiso par tan par dhan dhookhanaa tiradhokh man kahat kai chhaaddio chaahai Tev na Tarat hai ||539||

en.bdb: Similarly the three vices of ogling at other's wife, keeping an eye on other's wealth and slander are inhabiting in my mind like a chronic disease. Even if someone tells me to leave them, this bad habit cannot go away. (539)
